decisions.boundary_condition: Applies only to flight cabin-class selection; it does not imply preferences about seat position, airline, route, destination, travel dates, or non-flight travel products.
decisions.condition: When searching or booking flights and cabin class is open to preference selection.
decisions.default_action: Default to searching for and selecting business-class flight fares or seats.
decisions.exception_condition: If the user explicitly requests another cabin, states a budget that business class cannot meet, or no business-class option is available, do not silently force business class; ask for confirmation or present alternatives.
decisions.name: Business-class flight cabin default
decisions.rationale: Supported by multiple flight-booking examples where the user requests business class. This is a cabin-class preference and should not be merged with economy/coach because they are contrasting alternatives within the same preference family.

decisions.boundary_condition: Applies only to flight cabin or seating-class selection; it does not imply a preferred airline, route, travel date, departure time, seat position, or fare budget.
decisions.condition: When booking or searching for flights and a cabin or seating class is needed, if no trip-specific upgrade or different cabin is requested.
decisions.default_action: Default the flight cabin search to coach/economy seating.
decisions.exception_condition: If the user explicitly asks for or accepts a different cabin such as premium economy, business, or first class for the current trip, use that requested cabin instead of coach/economy.
decisions.name: Coach/economy flight cabin default
decisions.rationale: Supported by multiple flight-booking examples using coach/economy wording. This remains a separate alternative from business class because it is a contrasting cabin-class value, not an alias.
